title: Work memories: handle Beads schema_version key collision
outcome: Consolidated Claude reviewer session-7010 Low at src/work_memories.rs:160. Decoder unconditionally removes schema_version and requires numeric 1, so a string-valued user memory with that key invalidates the whole listing. Source-level edge case, not reproduced by writing a real user memory. Verify reserved-key behavior of supported bd first; distinguish numeric metadata from string memory content if the CLI exposes it. Add receipt regression and disclose upstream limitations rather than inventing recovery.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 3b, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-OBSOLETE. Beads was removed from the repository on 2026-10-03; no "beads" remains in src/work_*.rs on master.
